tasks.title: Add "anonymizationLink" to the document register's schemas array in lib/Settings/docudesk_register.json

Add the anonymizationLink schema object to components.schemas (12 properties, hardValidation:true, searchable:true, objectNameField sourceFileName, objectDescriptionField status, archival retention P7Y, category placeholder pending selectielijst sign-off)
Make status a single-value enum ["anonymized"] (only successful runs are recorded; failed value intentionally unused)
Declare sourceFileId and anonymizedFileId with facetable:true and type integer
Declare required: [sourceFileId, anonymizedFileId] on the schema
Bump info.version from 5.2.0 to 5.3.0
Add four seed objects for anonymizationLink to components.objects (all status anonymized, includes a runCount>1 example)
Add @spec annotation to anonymizeDocument PHPDoc referencing the change tasks
Add private method recordAnonymizationLink(int $fileId, array $resultInfo) with full PHPDoc
Resolve OCA\OpenRegister\Service\ObjectService via getOpenRegisterService()
searchObjects by @self{register:document,schema:anonymizationLink}+sourceFileId; capture first result or null
Build object: if existing, preserve @self + runCount+1; else fresh array runCount:1. Always status anonymized
saveObject(object, register:document, schema:anonymizationLink) using named parameters
Assign saved object id/uuid to $resultInfo['anonymizationLinkId'] and return updated $resultInfo
Wrap in try/catch(\Throwable); on failure log warning and return $resultInfo unchanged (best-effort, never abort)
Call recordAnonymizationLink on the SUCCESS path only (guard on anonymizedFileId present; never in failure branch)
Verify composer check:strict passes
Create test class following ConsentServiceTest mock pattern (mock ObjectService etc.)
testRecordAnonymizationLinkCreatesNewRecord (not-found -> create, runCount:1, anonymizationLinkId present)
testRecordAnonymizationLinkUpdatesExistingRecord (found -> update, runCount:2, @self preserved)
testRecordAnonymizationLinkIsBestEffortOnSaveFailure (saveObject throws -> no propagation, no anonymizationLinkId)
testRecordAnonymizationLinkIsBestEffortOnSearchFailure (searchObjects throws -> no propagation; document chosen branch)
Run unit tests in the Nextcloud container and confirm all pass
Confirm the four anonymizationLink seed objects are present in components.objects
Verify every seed object has status anonymized (no failed records)
Verify at least one object with runCount > 1 (re-anonymisation scenario)
Run composer check:strict in docudesk repo, zero errors
Verify docudesk_register.json is valid JSON
Confirm info.version is 5.3.0
Flag final x-openregister-archival.category for selectielijst manager; replace placeholder before archive
